notes: Syncro is now hooked up. New Settings tab: enter your Syncro subdomain + API token, test the connection, and pick a default asset type for phones. On the Device tab, 'Register in Syncro' now works: search the customer, and TM Phone creates (or updates) a phone asset pre-filled with model, serial, IMEI, UDID, iOS, battery health, storage and Activation Lock status.
